artDirection: Orthographic 3D toy kitchen: sage enamel, cream porcelain, honey oak, brushed copper, warm key and mint fill. Native text remains HTML/canvas text.

frames.use: .poster or dark result/help accent surface; use light native text
active game top overlay HUD only; native timer, score and buttons atop it
#orders .order when remaining time <=10s; coral frame and native light text

buttons.use: primary Solo, Start, Replay and other main actions; pressed state on :active
secondary Host/Join and game control buttons; pressed state on :active
light tertiary Help, Cancel and pairing buttons; pressed state on :active
disabled fullscreen or unavailable actions; disabled attribute still controls behavior

controls.use: #joystick, visual base; native pointer drag area remains >=44px
#action visual face, switch on pressed/held state; native accessible label

progress.use: live order, prep and pot progress recessed frame
live width 0..100% based on simulation; sage ready, coral urgent, gold working

icons.use: HUD, status, recipe, help and pairing; set aria-hidden on decorative img while native button label/aria-label names the control

illustrations.use: home poster kitchen backdrop with world agent 3D cat chef sprites overlaid

effects.use: serve burst; optional short scale/opacity animation, static on reduced motion
cooking pot; optional upward drift, static on reduced motion
simmer effect; optional rising motion, static on reduced motion
nearest interactable station at approximately 130x90 logical pixels, distinct from local-player ring
